手放稳些。你这一下，我瞧着，像。
试试锐眼。别死盯着看，先想它该往哪边让。

lines_en: No hurry. Wood is more honest than people—treat it well, and it treats you the same.
Steadier hands. That last move of yours—it looked right to me.
Try the Keen Eye. Don't stare it down—think first which way the wood would yield.
Has anything come back to you? Even the faintest thread counts.
...Was that asking too soon? Forget I said it.
Talent grows the more you use it. Every joint you close brings a piece of it back.
Tired of how I look? Once I've confirmed who you are, change me however you like.
I'm right here, no rush. Rest your hands whenever they ache.
This wood's nature favors going with the grain, not against it—ahem, never mind.

One joint at a time. It can't be rushed, and there's no need to rush.
That move just now... nothing stirred in you? No matter—pressing won't help.
